posts.title: Copilot and Antigravity cost nothing to start
posts.excerpt: The five-way comparison, with prices as of Nov 2, 2026, puts GitHub Copilot CLI on every Copilot plan, including Free, and Antigravity CLI on a $0 individual tier. Claude Code, by contrast, is not…
posts.body: [The five-way comparison](https://metarix.io/best-ai-cli-coding-agents), with prices as of Nov 2, 2026, puts GitHub Copilot CLI on every Copilot plan, including Free, and Antigravity CLI on a $0 individual tier. Claude Code, by contrast, is not included in Claude's free plan, so the no-cost way into a terminal agent runs through the other agents.

posts.title: NextDecade targets 2027 LNG production in Brownsville
posts.excerpt: NextDecade expects first liquefied natural gas production from Train 1 at its Brownsville facility in the second quarter of 2027. Substantial completion follows in the third quarter of 2027, a…
posts.body: NextDecade expects [first liquefied natural gas production](https://www.rgvbusinessjournal.com/news/02/11/2026/nextdecade-rio-grande-lng-brownsville-2027-production-article/) from Train 1 at its Brownsville facility in the second quarter of 2027. Substantial completion follows in the third quarter of 2027, a quarter before the guaranteed date under its contract with Bechtel Energy.

posts.title: DRAM prices have doubled in 2026
posts.excerpt: Memory makers are prioritizing supplies for artificial intelligence applications in data centers over commodity products such as personal computers. Personal computer shipments in Japan fell 30% from…
posts.body: Memory makers are [prioritizing supplies for artificial intelligence applications in data centers over commodity products such as personal computers](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/tech/semiconductors/dram-prices-double-in-2026-as-ai-focus-squeezes-pc-makers). Personal computer shipments in Japan fell 30% from a year earlier in the April-September period.

posts.title: Protein before lifting works as well as after
posts.excerpt: The 2025 meta-analysis compared protein taken before versus after resistance training across five studies lasting at least four weeks. Its practical takeaway is to spread protein servings every 3–4…
posts.body: The [2025 meta-analysis](https://www.mensjournal.com/food/protein-before-or-after-lifting-research-challenges-a-common-muscle-building-rule) compared protein taken before versus after resistance training across five studies lasting at least four weeks. Its practical takeaway is to spread protein servings every 3–4 hours across the day, rather than rushing a shake the moment a workout ends.

posts.title: Sam Altman calls the RAM in your PC a waste
posts.excerpt: Altman argued on the October 29 “Cheeky Pint” podcast that scarce DRAM belongs in cloud servers running at full tilt rather than in PCs running local AI models. OpenAI's own Stargate demand could…
posts.body: [Altman argued on the October 29 “Cheeky Pint” podcast](https://moneywise.com/news/top-stories/sam-altman-dram-pc-openai) that scarce DRAM belongs in cloud servers running at full tilt rather than in PCs running local AI models. OpenAI's own Stargate demand could reach as much as 40% of global DRAM output, based on TechInsights' 2025 production estimate.

posts.title: Pokémon Pokopia boots on a hacked PS5 through Linux
posts.excerpt: The clip shows Pokémon and objects rendering as black silhouettes over purple-tinted terrain, far from playable, though the game visibly loads into its world. It follows a PS5 Linux loader for older…
posts.body: The [clip](https://www.tweaktown.com/news/114422/pokemon-pokopia-boots-on-a-hacked-ps5-running-linux-days-after-the-first-switch-2-jailbreak/index.html) shows Pokémon and objects rendering as black silhouettes over purple-tinted terrain, far from playable, though the game visibly loads into its world. It follows a PS5 Linux loader for older launch-model consoles and an October 22 Switch 2 jailbreak that exposed the cryptographic keys emulator developers need.

posts.title: Drex Max v1 open weights run locally on Apple Silicon
posts.excerpt: Nace AI released Drex Max v1 as open weights, shipping bf16 weights and an affine Q4 checkpoint. The affine Q4 checkpoint runs on Apple Silicon Macs with 24 GB or more, so routing, classification and…
posts.body: [Nace AI released Drex Max v1 as open weights](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/01/nace-ai-open-sources-drex-max-v1-local-inference/), shipping bf16 weights and an affine Q4 checkpoint. posts.title: OpenCode 2.0 turns the coding agent into a shared background service
posts.excerpt: OpenCode 2.0 runs as a single persistent background service, so terminal, desktop, web and phone clients share the same live session. Its Code Mode lets the agent chain multiple tool calls into one…
posts.body: [OpenCode 2.0](https://medium.com/@mr.f00l210/opencode-2-0-is-here-how-the-open-source-coding-agent-became-a-shared-background-service-a354024358a7) runs as a single persistent background service, so terminal, desktop, web and phone clients share the same live session. Its Code Mode lets the agent chain multiple tool calls into one JavaScript program instead of calling tools one by one.

posts.body: The [PS5 Linux project](https://videocardz.com/newz/ps5-linux-project-adds-ps5-pro-support-runs-ubuntu-on-firmware-13-60) now boots an Ubuntu desktop on a jailbroken retail PS5 Pro running firmware 13.60. posts.title: Green-card holders are out of SBA-financed buyouts
posts.excerpt: Lawful permanent residents are now treated as ineligible for SBA-financed acquisitions under a rule in effect since March 1, which requires every owner and required guarantor to be a U.S. citizen or…
posts.body: [Lawful permanent residents are now treated as ineligible](https://www.munizzilaw.com/blog/sba-acquisition-rules-sop-50-10-8-1) for SBA-financed acquisitions under a rule in effect since March 1, which requires every owner and required guarantor to be a U.S. citizen or national living in the United States. The rule looks back six months, so a business cannot qualify if an ineligible person owned any part of it in that window unless that person gave up every bit of the interest before the loan number issues.

posts.title: Open-source MiniCPM-OCR parses documents with a 1.3B model
posts.excerpt: The MiniCPM-OCR release from ModelBest and OpenBMB centers on a 1.3-billion-parameter model that parses scanned, photographed, curved and tilted documents without image pre-correction. Its 2B…
posts.body: The [MiniCPM-OCR release](https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20261031cn86192/modelbest-and-openbmb-open-source-minicpm-ocr-series-delivering-high-performance-document-parsing-and-ai-powered-quality-control) from ModelBest and OpenBMB centers on a 1.3-billion-parameter model that parses scanned, photographed, curved and tilted documents without image pre-correction. Its 2B companion, Jev, compares OCR output with the source image and flags errors for human review.

posts.title: PC DRAM hits a record as AI servers take the capacity
posts.excerpt: The mainstream DDR4 chip averaged $27.50 in October, a record since TrendForce's survey began in June 2016. TrendForce now sees Korean PC DRAM output falling by more than 40% next year as Samsung and…
posts.body: The mainstream DDR4 chip [averaged $27.50 in October](https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-it/2026/10/30/ASPG5INZZBFOTDGSVINATFQVDI/), a record since TrendForce's survey began in June 2016. TrendForce now sees Korean PC DRAM output falling by more than 40% next year as Samsung and SK hynix shift capacity to AI server memory.

posts.title: 63 weekly sets gained nothing over normal volume

posts.body: Adding about 50% more weekly lower-body sets gave trained athletes no detectable advantage in thigh-muscle thickness in [the 2026 experiment](https://mindmuscleperfection.com/high-volume-strength-training-60-sets-muscle-growth-2026/). The normal-volume group performed better on the deadlift.

posts.title: Factory Droid 1.0 runs tools through scripts
posts.excerpt: Factory Droid 1.0 makes programmatic tool calling the default, so the model writes a JavaScript program that runs hundreds of tool calls in a single pass inside a sandbox. Factory's self-reported…
posts.body: [Factory Droid 1.0](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/31/factory-droid-1-0-frontier-harness/) makes programmatic tool calling the default, so the model writes a JavaScript program that runs hundreds of tool calls in a single pass inside a sandbox. Factory's self-reported Terminal-Bench 4 run put it at 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5.

posts.title: Vercel ships agent-desktop for coding agents
posts.excerpt: agent-desktop lets coding agents read and operate desktop apps through the operating system's accessibility tree on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It embeds no model, so agents call it as a tool and keep…
posts.body: [agent-desktop](https://subagentic.ai/posts/vercel-labs-agent-desktop/) lets coding agents read and operate desktop apps through the operating system's accessibility tree on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It embeds no model, so agents call it as a tool and keep the observe, act, and verify loop themselves.

posts.title: Lengthened partials showed no edge over full reps
posts.excerpt: In the October 2026 experiment, 16 trained men worked one leg through full-range reps and the other through lengthened partials. Thigh muscle grew under both approaches over eight weeks, with no…
posts.body: In [the October 2026 experiment](https://mindmuscleperfection.com/lengthened-partials-vs-full-range-of-motion-muscle-growth/), 16 trained men worked one leg through full-range reps and the other through lengthened partials. Thigh muscle grew under both approaches over eight weeks, with no clear advantage for the partials.

posts.title: Anthropic files for IPO with soaring revenue, massive losses
posts.excerpt: Revenue reached $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $1.16 billion a year earlier, in the prospectus Anthropic filed on October 26. Most of the $80.7 billion loss was paper: a $72.4…
posts.body: Revenue reached $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $1.16 billion a year earlier, in the [prospectus Anthropic filed on October 26](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-10-27/Anthropic-files-for-IPO-reveals-soaring-revenue-massive-net-losses-1RzGVHGukKY/share_amp.html). Most of the $80.7 billion loss was paper: a $72.4 billion charge for revaluing convertible notes as Anthropic's valuation climbed.
